H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H637: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5035: a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form)
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1077: properly, a failure; by implication nothing; usually (adverb) not at all; also lest
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H7834: a powder (as beaten small); by analogy, a thin vapor; by extension, the firmament
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H2502: to pull off; hence (intensively) to strip, (reflex.) to depart; by implication, to deliver, equip (for fight); present, strengthen
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H5937: to jump for joy, i.e. exult
H2505: to be smooth (figuratively); by implication (as smooth stones were used for lots) to apportion or separate
H5523: Succoth, the name of a place in Egypt and of three in Palestine
H4058: properly, to stretch; by implication, to measure (as if by stretching a line); figuratively, to be extended
H1568: Gilad, a region East of the Jordan; also the name of three Israelites
H4519: Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
H669: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
H4581: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H3063: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
H2710: properly, to hack, i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe
H4124: Moab, an incestuous son of Lot; also his territory and descendants
H5518: a pot; also a thorn (as springing up rapidly); by implication, a hook
H123: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H5275: properly, a sandal tongue; by extension a sandal or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless)
H7321: to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H2986: properly, to flow; causatively, to bring (especially with pomp)
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H4013: a fortification, castle, or fortified city; figuratively, a defender
H5148: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H3051: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H7723: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
H8668: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
